reuse.why: Extends the existing shared isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every holiday check in the tree already uses.

duplication.why: A two-line change in one function; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The holiday format is interpreted in shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay, where the tree decides non-working days.

scope.why: Predicate, a type comment, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Minimal, documented change at the single point of truth.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and schedules/app.ts all go through isNonWorkingDay.
